claim_scores.rationale: `main()` calls `dspy.configure(lm=base_lm, trace=[])` before `asyncio.gather(...)`, so the entry async task establishes the global defaults first.
`forbidden_configure()` attempts `dspy.configure(...)` in a sibling task, catches the `RuntimeError`, and the program asserts the error mentions the same-async-task restriction.
Per-task overrides use `with dspy.context(lm=local_lm, trace=[tag])`, and the later global-state assertion shows the overrides were temporary and restored after exit.
Two concurrent `allowed_context(...)` tasks run under separate contexts and assert distinct `(lm.tag, trace)` values: `('task-one', ['task-one'])` and `('task-two', ['task-two'])`.
After `gather(...)`, the program reads and asserts `dspy.settings.lm.tag == 'base'` and `dspy.settings.trace == []`, confirming the outer defaults stayed unchanged.
